title: A novel time-domain iterative method for a three-dimensional inverse acoustic obstacle scattering problem
summary: This paper concerns the three-dimensional forward and inverse acoustic obstacle scattering problem in the time domain. For the forward problem, a retarded potential formulation discretized by convolution quadrature and Galerkin methods is introduced. By introducing the retarded boundary integral defined on a homothetic surface, we propose a novel time-domain convolution quadrature based iterative method to reconstruct both the shape and location of a rigid obstacle.
